name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet
prompt: 32x32 pixel art sprite of a single tulumbacı, an 18th-century Janissary firefighter of Istanbul, standing ready, rendered across eight compass-direction rotations, isolated on a transparent background, no environment. Male, mid-30s, lean and quick rather than heavily built, skin ruddy from smoke and heat exposure, a soot-darkened mustache with clean-shaven chin, close-cropped hair beneath a white felt börk scorched at one edge, its brass kaşıklık holder blackened, worn low and practical rather than for display. Wearing a heavy dark wool coat cut short at the knee for running through narrow Istanbul alleys, sleeves cinched tight, a plain leather sash, coarse şalvar trousers, sturdy leather boots. A hand axe for breaking through burning timber hangs from the belt, a long brass fire hook carried over one shoulder for pulling down collapsing structures, and slung across his back the wooden barrel and leather hose of a hand-pump water apparatus, its brass fittings dulled by soot. Burn scars visible on both forearms. Expression alert, urgent, the readiness of a man who may be called out at any hour of the night. Bold, saturated period-appropriate color palette, thick clean black outlines for silhouette clarity at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
